sourceRef.section: 3. Unusual Creatures, 3.1 Profiles, 3.2 Abilities and Upgrades

description: Creatures relying on deception, mutation, unusual movement, and supernatural control.

abilities.name: Perfect Disguise
abilities.effect: Cannot normally be identified as a creature before moving or attacking without a successful Awareness Check or another appropriate detection effect.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.effect: The Mimic's first Attack of the encounter gains Accurate 2.

upgrades.name: Adhesive Grip
upgrades.description: If Bite inflicts Damage, the target suffers Slow 1.

upgrades.name: Greater Mimic
upgrades.description: Increase Wounds to W7 and gain Impact 1.

abilities.name: Amorphous
abilities.effect: Cannot make Evade Saves and ignores effects that forcibly reposition it. May flow through sufficiently large openings.

upgrades.name: Split
upgrades.description: Once per battle, at 4 or fewer remaining Wounds, replace this Model with a single Unit of two Lesser Oozes. Distribute its remaining Wounds between them, maximum W2 each. The resulting Unit retains its activation status and cannot gain an additional activation from splitting.

upgrades.name: Corrosive Body
upgrades.description: Once per activation, when an enemy inflicts Damage on the Ooze in Engagement, that enemy suffers one automatic Physical Hit at Damage 1.

abilities.name: Elemental Nature
abilities.effect: Choose one element when creating the Unit.

elementOptions.name: Fire
elementOptions.description: Elemental Strike gains the Fire attribute. When it Surges, it gains Blast 1" for that Attack.

elementOptions.name: Ice
elementOptions.description: Elemental Strike gains the Frost attribute. When it Surges, its target suffers Slow 1.

elementOptions.name: Storm
elementOptions.description: Elemental Strike gains the Lightning attribute; increase Move to M6".

elementOptions.name: Stone
elementOptions.description: Improve Armor to 4+ but reduce Move to M4".

upgrades.name: Standard Elementals
upgrades.description: Two Models with the selected elemental form.

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.effect: May move over terrain and Models, finishing legally.

abilities.name: Petrifying Venom
abilities.effect: If Beak and Talons inflicts an unsaved Hit, the target suffers Slow 1. If it also generated a Surge, apply Slow 2 instead.

upgrades.name: Greater Cockatrice
upgrades.description: Increase Wounds to W7 and gain Impact 1.

units.name: Basilisk

attackProfiles.name: Petrifying Gaze
attackProfiles.effect: Petrifying Gaze inflicts no ordinary Damage. If it scores at least one Hit, its target suffers Slow 2. If the target was already under Slow 2 from this Basilisk before the Attack began, it also suffers Direct Damage 1. This additional Damage is applied only once per Attack.

abilities.name: Petrifying Glare
abilities.effect: Choose a visible enemy Unit within 8". Roll 2D6; each 5+ is one Success. On at least one Success, the target becomes Staggered (it forfeits one eligible phase activation). The target may negate the effect with one applicable Magic Ward Save, if any. This is a magical Command, not an ordinary Assault Attack. It does not also apply Slow.

abilities.name: Stone Scales
abilities.effect: Temporary effects cannot worsen the Basilisk's Armor by more than one step during a single Round.

upgrades.name: Elder Basilisk
upgrades.description: Increase Wounds to W10 and Gaze Range to 10".

notes: In Narrative Combat, full petrification may occur after sustained exposure, a special challenge, or a suitable encounter consequence. A single Hit does not permanently petrify a PC.

units.name: Rust Eater

abilities.name: Corrosive Bite
abilities.effect: If Corrosive Mandibles inflicts an unsaved Hit against an Armored Unit or Construct, worsen its Armor by one step until the end of its next activation. This effect does not stack with itself.

abilities.name: Scent of Iron
abilities.effect: Gain Accurate 1 when attacking Armored Units or Constructs.

upgrades.name: Standard Rust Eater
upgrades.description: Corrosive Mandibles, Corrosive Bite, Scent of Iron.

upgrades.name: Greater Corrosion
upgrades.description: Corrosive Bite's Armor penalty lasts until the end of the next Round.

upgrades.name: Iron Maw
upgrades.description: Increase Corrosive Mandibles to four Attacks.

notes: Corrosion is normally temporary in Structured Combat. Permanent equipment destruction requires a separate narrative or scenario rule.

abilities.name: Flicker
abilities.effect: Once per Round, when targeted by a ranged Attack, improve Evade from 4+ to 3+ against that Attack. Declare before the attacker rolls.

abilities.name: Phase Step
abilities.effect: Move up to 4", ignoring intervening terrain and Models. Must finish legally and cannot finish Engaged. If originally Engaged, the Phase Stalker becomes Withdrawn.

upgrades.name: Ambush Predator
upgrades.description: Its next Phase Claws Attack after Phase Step this Round gains Accurate 1.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
abilities.effect: Ignore intervening terrain and Models when moving, finishing legally.

abilities.name: Luring Glow
abilities.effect: When Ghostlight generates a Surge, its target suffers Slow 1.

upgrades.name: Standard Lights
upgrades.description: Three Models with Ghostlight and Luring Glow.

upgrades.name: Blinding Flash
upgrades.description: On a Ghostlight Surge, the target also worsens Hit by one step on its next Attack this Round.

abilities.name: Impact 1
abilities.effect: Add 1 automatic Physical Hit(s) to the normal highest-die Charge Impact (before Brace).

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.effect: At the beginning of each Round, Heal 1 if within natural terrain. Regrowth does not trigger if the Mound suffered Fire Damage since its previous activation.

abilities.name: Entangling Growth
abilities.effect: If Crushing Vines inflicts an unsaved Hit, its target suffers Slow 1.

upgrades.name: Deep Roots
upgrades.description: Improve Armor to 3+ while within natural terrain.

upgrades.name: Grasping Tendrils
upgrades.description: Increase Crushing Vines Range to Engaged 3".

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.effect: May move over terrain and Models, finishing legally.

abilities.name: Stone Stillness
abilities.effect: Gain Concealed while stationary in suitable stone terrain, ending when the Unit Attacks, enters Engagement, or Moves.

abilities.name: Unliving Stone
abilities.effect: Gain Tough 1 against Physical Attacks while stationary.

upgrades.name: Standard Guardians
upgrades.description: Three Models with Flying and Stone Stillness.
